about.intro: Awdah means return. It is a quiet companion for coming back to your prayer and your deen, one day at a time.
about.whatBody: A 30-day path of small daily steps, prayer tracking, dhikr, and short lessons, followed by a steady routine to keep going.
about.freeBody: Awdah is made as sadaqah jariyah, an ongoing charity, with the intention of seeking Allah's pleasure. There are no ads, no purchases and no data collection.
about.sourcesBody: Hadith and duas are cited with their sources. If you notice a mistake, please let us know so it can be corrected.

privacy.intro: Awdah does not collect any data about you.

storage.title: Stored on your device
storage.body: Everything you enter, such as your profile, prayers, tasks and journal, is stored only on this phone.

accounts.title: No accounts, analytics or ads
accounts.body: There are no accounts, no analytics, no advertising and no trackers. Nothing is sent to us or to anyone else.

location.title: Location
location.body: If you choose to set your location, it is used only on your phone to calculate prayer times. It is never sent anywhere.

backups.title: Backups
backups.body: Backups are files that you create and keep. You decide where they go and who can see them.

deletion.title: Deleting your data
deletion.body: You can erase everything in Settings, and uninstalling Awdah deletes all of its data from your phone.

terms.intro: These are the plain terms for using Awdah.

guidance.title: Personal guidance
guidance.body: Awdah is for personal spiritual guidance and reminders. It is not a source of religious rulings.

scholars.title: Not a fatwa
scholars.body: Nothing in the app is a fatwa. For questions about your situation, please consult a qualified scholar.

asIs.title: As is
asIs.body: The app is offered free, as is, without warranties. We do our best to be accurate, and we may fix or change content over time.

yourData.title: Your data
yourData.body: Your data stays on your phone and is yours. See the Privacy page for details.

days.a: Your 30-day path follows the calendar. Day 1 is the day you began, and each new date brings the next day automatically.

missed.q: What if I miss a day?
missed.a: Nothing is lost and nothing is punished. The path keeps moving with the calendar, and you can open any past day from Journey to catch up.

past.q: Can I complete past or future days?
past.a: You can edit past days from Journey. Future days stay locked until their date arrives.

prayers.q: How do I mark my prayers?
prayers.a: On the Today screen, tap a prayer on the horizon to mark it as prayed. Tap again to undo.

tasbih.a: Count your dhikr in the Worship tab. When a day's step asks for a dhikr and you reach its target, that step is completed for you.

language.q: How do I change the language?
language.a: Open Me, then Settings, and choose your language. Right-to-left languages take full effect after restarting the app.

reset.q: How do I erase my data?
reset.a: Open Me, then Settings, and tap Erase all data twice. This removes your profile and progress. Your language and theme are kept.
